lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters; central flank exhibits vertical columns containing three primary centroids between longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity vertical bands intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges present on the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance peaks to shadowed troughs immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately seven high-luminance blobs contained within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered toward the leading edge and lower half.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or loss of tissue on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition from large lateral blobs to high-density, low-diameter speckling on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
